Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Identity: yes, we use Okta (SCIM + SAML). We need SCIM provisioning to be supported for user sync to the service.
- Keys/HSM: we use AWS CloudHSM and require that customer-managed keys be used for any production encryption-at-rest. Ideally Redwood can integrate with CloudHSM or allow keys controlled from our KMS.
- Logs: regulator requires retention of auth/access logs + transaction audit trails for 7 years. Logs must be immutable and exportable for audits.
- Volume: pilot numbers are smaller — pilot ~10–20M tokens/mo; production could reach ~150–250M tokens/mo within 12 months.
- Timeline: procurement + security review target Q3 (aim to have final decision by late July).

Can you confirm whether Dedicated supports customer KMS integrations and whether Dedicated or Private is required for CloudHSM? Also share the evidence list you mentioned (SOC2, pen test, config guides).

Thanks Alexa — quick clarifying notes on deployment capabilities so you have a concrete mapping before the security call: 

- Hosted API (Redwood-hosted): fastest to get started, but does NOT support customer-managed KMS/HSM or private SCIM integrations tied to a customer's Okta tenant. Log retention is standard (90 days) and not configurable to multi-year retention. Not recommended for FintechCo given KMS/HSM + 7-year retention needs.

- Dedicated (reserved capacity): gives you a dedicated GPU pool and network isolation. It supports customer-managed KMS via cloud-provider KMS integrations (we can integrate with customer AWS KMS keys). However, native HSM (CloudHSM) integrations and fully isolated HSM appliance attachments are generally available only with Private deployments or dedicated on-prem installations; for certain enterprise accounts we can arrange a Private-like Dedicated setup with more controls (we'll confirm feasibility). Log retention on Dedicated can be extended beyond default, typically configurable up to 12 months in-platform; for longer retention (7+ years) we recommend exporting logs to customer-managed long-term storage (S3 with object lock) — this is something Private deployments do by default.

- Private (VPC / on-prem): full control — supports your Okta SCIM/SAML integrations, direct KMS/HSM attachments, and long-term immutable log retention to meet 7-year regulatory requirements. This is the most prescriptive option for auditors.

Next steps I propose for the security call:
1) We'll have our Security Engineer (Monica) and Solutions Engineer join to go over CloudHSM integration patterns and the log export/immuatability approach.
2) We'll share a short matrix doc (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with yes/no for SCIM, customer KMS, native HSM, and max native retention.
3) I'll ask Product to confirm whether we can support an HSM gateway for Dedicated in special cases; if not, we'll outline Private deployment options.

Proposed follow-up: Wed 6/17 14:00–15:00 PT — Monica will send calendar invite with a short agenda and required attendees.

Thanks — Rishi
